Read tools (get_instance, list_nodes, get_node, list_apps, get_app, list_actions, get_action, search_audit, map_packs_list, work_tasks_list, work_task_get, get_backup_status, list_backup_runs, list_backup_snapshots, get_os_updates, get_os_update_history, stat_file, list_machines, get_machine, get_storage, list_alerts, get_alert, get_update_settings, read_app_logs), one request-only tool (request_action) and onemind:// resources. No approve tool. Notifications get 202; over the per-agent message limit, 429.
